statement: The case evidence register has no Jincheon-specific future payment path for continuing the disclosed plan.
limitation: This is a register gap rather than a claim that no payment obligation exists outside the reviewed public material.

statement: The KRX disclosure reports 36 percent physical construction progress through May 2026.
limitation: Physical progress is not a cash-disbursement percentage and cannot derive remaining capex or a defer-world cash path.

statement: The case evidence register has no project-specific payment schedule aligned to the 2026-08-18 cutoff.
limitation: No calendar timing is inferred from the public total-investment plan or physical progress.

statement: The case evidence register has no same-scope after-tax incremental cash-flow basis for continue versus defer.
limitation: Parent financial statements do not supply a project-specific tax and cash-component bridge.

statement: The case scope is parent standalone and the cited DART cash-flow source is separately reported parent financial information.
limitation: A parent standalone scope does not allocate a project payment or prove that group cash and facilities are legally accessible to the project.

statement: A filed parent-standalone cash-flow statement is available by the cutoff.
limitation: It is not a project sources-and-uses schedule and does not establish committed or legally accessible Jincheon funding.

statement: The case evidence register has no contract term establishing unilateral delay phase or cancellation rights and associated penalties for the Jincheon project.
limitation: No defer or no-build right is modeled merely because a public investment plan describes a target schedule.
